name: Gap P
source:
Main character is a slightly weak boy. He can not confess to the girl he likes for a long time. But everything changes after meeting demoness Pumy who promises to help him confess after transforming to the girl he likes. At times practice sessions turn into sensual lessons. What will happen after confession to the real girl?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一个稍微弱小的男孩。他很长一段时间都无法向自己喜欢的女孩表白。但在遇到妖女普米后一切都发生了变化，普米答应在变身为他喜欢的女孩后帮助他表白。有时练习会变成感官课程。向真正的女孩告白后会发生什么？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
